purpose: source-distinct candidate SEC event packets for a fresh insight-quality arm
ranking_rule: Within each v2 extension pool, remove every issuer observed in v2 and sort remaining symbols by SHA-256(ranking_seed + '|' + stratum + '|' + symbol), ascending.
source_rule: Public SEC 8-K quarterly earnings exhibits filed by 2025-12-31; locate the two latest adjacent reported fiscal quarters, verify actual period/basis/units/rows and source bytes before any model answer. Source ineligibility is documented before replacement by the next ranked unused candidate.
scope_limit: Discovery ranking is not final eligibility, source audit, experimental preregistration, or quality evidence. Only a later frozen source-distinct panel with new authorized sessions can test the correction.
